Q: iRSI() does not open an order at the end of a time frame A:

The iRSI response is a handle to the indicator, not a indicator value.

Q: What could be the cause of the error message: The current path, hello/, didn’t match any of these A:

path('hello/', include('hello.urls'))

You will see the issue happening if you just have it as: path('hello', include('hello.urls'))

Q: Stuck on "Connected" A:

Heyho folks...

Got the same Problem but on other OS (Linux Server 20.04.5): stucking on authentificationscreen or better, Authentification and then the Message: 'Lost Connection' ...

PAST: I updatet my Server-php for gmp-functions, to be able to get a registerscript running for my server. Since then, all went fail -.- : First I got a fail in the screens with DB-Connection, so i had to update my php-lib... after that, there was a ne fail with the vmmaps(someNumber), so i loaded the Maps in data-file all new and substituted them, after that i compiled all new. Fail three comes around as Failurmessage in the screens of authserver and worldserver, anything about 'UseSocketActivation' -> google helpt and I added

Network.UseSocketActivation = 0

to authserver.conf.dist and to worldserver.conf.dist -- and recompiled a second time. After all those steps, now my screens (auth- and woldserver) on my home-server are working fine, if i look with ssh onto them...

PRESENT: But login in with the Client (from another PC in my Home-LAN) brings me to the situation mentioned above.

Now first I checked the acore_auth_realmlist-Database, seems all to be right, all entries as befor... Next step was to think about the ufw, but to disable didn't help - Open Ports are 8085, 3724, 22, 80, 443 (as they were when it worked befor all that fails, i repaiered...). Realmlist in the Client I didn't changed, so it should work of course. I deleted the cache-WDB serveral times, but it didn't change anything.

I'm just out of ideas now and hope, anyone out there got a solution... :-\ -- Pleas help!
